The '''helmet of metal feathers''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]] ''that was recovered in the [[Kin's Store Room]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|4}}{{ref/book|8|20}}

==Appearance==
The helmet is covered with what appears to be fluffy metal feathers.

==Use==
The use of this ''ter'angreal'' is unknown. When [[Elayne]] tested it with a thread of Fire, she gave everyone except herself within twenty paces a blinding headache.{{ref/book|8|20}}
